# Verify-change skill migration

This coherent instruction-only layer contributes to [#546](https://github.com/Gibbs-Morris/mississippi/issues/546)
and [#532](https://github.com/Gibbs-Morris/mississippi/issues/532). The
[recorded plan](https://github.com/Gibbs-Morris/mississippi/issues/546#issuecomment-5848470852)
precedes implementation. Introduction, mandatory routes, local bindings, and
verified removal belong in one layer of existing native stack #680. The user authorized independent parallel preparation and draft publication;
readiness still requires current CI and review evidence for every layer.

## Source map and retained authority

| Source | Disposition |
| --- | --- |
| Complete build/testing/Copilot Rules, prefixes, frontmatter, and audience | Retained exactly; one mandatory verify-change route added to each Rules section. |
| Build Quick-Start, benchmark, Core Principles, Procedures | Replaced by the portable workflow and source-backed local check binding. Required build, full cleanup, tests, warning policy, and CPM rules remain always-on. |
| Testing Quick-Start, level table/filter prose, Core Principles, baseline/legacy loops | Replaced by check selection and the binding. All test, coverage, naming, determinism, MTP/nonempty execution, legacy-scope, and package Rules remain intact. |
| Testing optional-mutation route | Retained, including direct-file fallback; mutation remains a distinct capability. |
| Copilot Quick-Start/Core Principles and cleanup details/benchmark | Removed as repetition of retained Rules and canonical scripts. |
| Actual commands, switches, and scope | [README](../../README.md#ci--local-pipeline-options), [script catalogue/CI mapping](../../eng/src/agent-scripts/README.md#script-catalogue), wrappers, and module implementation remain authoritative. |
| Unavailable discovery | Each adapter directly links the skill and binding; policy remains effective independently of automatic selection. |

The [portable skill](../../.agents/skills/verify-change/SKILL.md) has no Mississippi
paths, numeric quality thresholds, or tool pre-approvals. Its
[local binding](verify-change-bindings.md) distinguishes iteration, final cleanup,
L0/L1, separate L2/L3/docs/PowerShell/remote checks, and source-bound reuse.
The old FullyQualifiedName filtering prose is replaced by the module's actual
project-filename level selection. UX and semantic browser assertions remain
with their existing policy owner. Custom agents, AGENTS, application code,
scripts, packages, lockfiles, and workflows are unchanged.

## Validation and remaining behavioral evidence

Structural validation, configured Markdown lint, JSON parsing with duplicate-key
and 19 unique-case-ID checks, local file links, exact Rules/prefix/scope comparison,
portable metadata/body checks, owned-path exclusions, and whitespace checks
pass for this preparation. The [19-case rubric](verify-change-skill-cases.json)
is evaluation input, not evidence that its expected behavior occurred.

A fresh worker using this chat's inherited model and settings selected the skill
from a supplied six-skill file catalog and ran the consuming fixture's canonical
build, read-only format, and test sequence. Two syntax checks, six format checks,
and four assertions passed. Root independently checked all 21 input hashes and
the three report hashes: inputs stayed identical and reports match their source.
The portable skill LF SHA-256 below matches the trial input. This is bounded
file-catalog behavior evidence, not native CLI/app/IDE discovery or the complete
19-case matrix. Copilot behavior and review remain deferred and unverified under
the user's instruction until verified capacity returns.

Application behavior and build inputs are unchanged. Applicable current-head/base
CI and review remain pending for draft readiness; historical application test
results are reused only for their unchanged, recorded inputs.

## Rollback

Revert the complete layer together: restore the three instruction files and
remove only verify-change's skill, binding, rubric, and audit. Verify original
Rules/scopes and unchanged consumer paths, and preserve preceding skills and
other migrations. Final AGENTS consolidation remains a separate later layer.
